file_impact.reason: Wrap the local web-search tool so DDGSException is caught at rebar's own boundary: return an empty result list for the indistinguishable 'No results found.' case, and an explicit degraded marker naming the backend failure otherwise. Neither branch re-raises, so a web-search outcome can no longer void an entire plan review.

Red/green tests: monkeypatch the client to raise DDGSException('No results found.') and assert an empty list is returned rather than raised; raise DDGSException('backend exploded') and assert the degraded marker carries that text; assert web_search_capabilities installs rebar's wrapper rather than pydantic-ai's raw tool. No live network.
